tips.title: Legs & Lungs Blitz
tips.markdown:
## Legs & Lungs Blitz
Blast those quads and fill those lungs.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Jog up and down stairs — 3 min
- High knees in place — 1 min
- Arm circles — 1 min
**The Circuit** _(repeat 3 rounds)_
1. Stair sprints — 30 seconds
2. Step-ups — 15 per leg
3. Squat jumps — 15
4. Stair lunges — 10 per leg
5. High plank hold — 30 seconds
**Finisher**
- Stair burpees — AMRAP 1 min
**Cool-Down**
- Forward fold stretch — 1 min

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Core + Climb Crusher
tips.markdown:
## Core + Climb Crusher
Strengthen your center while you climb.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Brisk walk up and down stairs — 3 min
- Arm swings — 1 min
- Leg swings — 1 min
**The Circuit** _(repeat 3 rounds)_
1. Incline push-ups — 15
2. Russian twists — 20
3. Mountain climbers on stairs — 30 seconds
4. V-ups — 15
5. Plank knee tucks — 10 per leg
**Finisher**
- Sit-ups — AMRAP 1 min
**Cool-Down**
- Seated forward bend — 1 min

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Sprint Intervals
tips.markdown:
## Sprint Intervals
Speed and agility in quick bursts.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Light jog — 3 min
- Butt kicks — 1 min
- Dynamic stretches — 1 min
**The Circuit** _(repeat 4 rounds)_
1. Stair sprints — 20 seconds
2. Lateral steps — 20 per side
3. Jumping jacks — 30 seconds
4. High knees — 30 seconds
5. Incline push-ups — 15
**Finisher**
- Stair sprint — all out 1 min
**Cool-Down**
- Quad stretch — 30 seconds per leg

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Full-Body Burner
tips.markdown:
## Full-Body Burner
Hit every muscle from head to toe.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Jumping jacks — 2 min
- Arm swings — 1 min
- Leg swings — 1 min
**The Circuit** _(repeat 4 rounds)_
1. Stair sprints — 30 seconds
2. Step-ups — 15 per leg
3. Tricep dips on stairs — 15
4. Plank jacks — 20
5. Bear crawls up stairs — 30 seconds
**Finisher**
- Squat hold — 1 min
**Cool-Down**
- Child's pose — 1 min

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Upper-Body Push
tips.markdown:
## Upper-Body Push
Focus on chest, shoulders, triceps.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Arm circles — 2 min
- High knees — 1 min
- Dynamic chest stretch — 2 min
**The Circuit** _(repeat 3 rounds)_
1. Incline push-ups — 15
2. Tricep dips — 15
3. High plank to low plank — 10
4. Diamond push-ups on stairs — 10
5. Bear crawl — 30 seconds
**Finisher**
- Push-up hold — 30 seconds
**Cool-Down**
- Shoulder stretch — 1 min per side

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Glutes Galore
tips.markdown:

2. Glute bridges with foot on step — 15
3. Step-ups — 20 per leg
4. Squat jumps — 15
5. Calf raises on step — 20
**Finisher**
- Squat hold with pulse — 30 seconds

3. Plank shoulder taps — 15 per side
4. High knees — 45 seconds
5. Tricep dips — 15
**Finisher**

tips.title: EMOM Energy
tips.markdown:
## EMOM Energy
Every minute, on the minute. Feel the rush.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Jumping jacks — 2 min
- High knees — 1 min
- Dynamic stretches — 2 min
**The Circuit** _(10 rounds)_
1. Minute 1: Stair sprints — 45 seconds
2. Minute 2: Incline push-ups — 15
3. Minute 3: Step-ups — 20 per leg
4. Minute 4: Mountain climbers — 45 seconds
5. Minute 5: Rest
**Finisher**
- Burpees — AMRAP 1 min
**Cool-Down**
- Child’s pose — 1 min

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._

tips.title: Descending Ladder Challenge
tips.markdown:
## Descending Ladder Challenge
Build up, strip down. Keep pushing.
**Warm-Up** _(~5 min)_
- Stair walk — 3 min
- Arm circles — 1 min
- Leg swings — 1 min
**The Circuit** _(repeat 4 rounds)_
1. Round 1: Stair sprints — 1 min
2. Round 2: Stair sprints — 45 seconds
3. Round 3: Stair sprints — 30 seconds
4. Round 4: Stair sprints — 15 seconds
5. Bear crawl back to start — 30 seconds
**Finisher**
- Sit-up hold — 1 min
**Cool-Down**
- Stretch arms and legs — 1 min

_Friday Stairs is a community workout, not medical advice. Check with a doc before starting anything new._
